_comment: Bernina diffractometer setups: held constraints and solution ranges (min/max a solution may have, on top of the motor limits). Same names and format as eco's RecSpace.set_constraints (eco.utilities.recspace_hklforge.CONSTRAINT_PRESETS); converted from the former apps/bernina_parameters/*.json, whose ranges on held angles were redundant (and HGeom's chi 0..0 contradicted chi = 90).

sd.description: SD: surface diffractometer (You-B), phi axis horizontal (x-)

sd_horizontal.description: SD: surface diffractometer (You-B), chi = 90: phi axis vertical (y-)

sd_vertical_elbow_down.description: SD: surface diffractometer (You-B), eta = -90 (elbow down), phi axis horizontal (x-)

sd_vertical_elbow_up.description: SD: surface diffractometer (You-B), eta = +90 (elbow up), phi axis horizontal (x-)

thc.description: THC chamber, chi = 90 and phi = 0, eta free
